programs.title: VIP Pets
programs.desc: What a thrill! All the VIP Pets are going to spend the day together at a festival. What could be better than a fun day with friends? Oh no... the problem is...they cannot agree on what they want to do there!

programs.title: LEGO City Adventures
programs.desc: When Rooky learns that it's Chief Wheeler's birthday, she is determined to make it a memorable one.
